subject: Temporary coverage & IC swap for Q4 performance calibration window
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Temporary coverage & IC swap for Q4 performance calibration window

Hi Monica and Laura —

Quick heads-up and ask: Priya is moving to parental leave starting 1/4 and we need a short-term coverage plan for her IC responsibilities during the Jan performance calibration window (1/11–1/22). The priorities are: 1) preserve calibration signals for the ML infra cohort, 2) avoid blocking feature releases that rely on her experiments, and 3) keep upward feedback channels open.

I sketched a minimal coverage plan (attached) that proposes:
- Reassign Priya's weekly 1:1s to Monica for the first two weeks of Jan.
- Temporary IC-swap: allocate Samir (platform eng) 0.4 FTE for the first three weeks to manage experiment runs; redirection budget to come from team PD.
- Delay one non-critical release (metrics-export v0.9) by one sprint to free capacity if needed.

Requesting:
1) Manager approval to reassign 0.4 FTE for Samir (will need manager signoff + short DocuSign).
2) HR exception to treat this as a short-term IC swap under the freeze (we're within the exception criteria but need written approval).

I've attached the coverage plan and a one-page manager approval request. Can you confirm by EOD Tuesday so we can loop in HR/legal?

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Platform Product
Redwood Inference

Attachments: q4_temp_coverage_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), mgr_approval_request.pdf (pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Temporary coverage & IC swap for Q4 performance calibration window

Rachel — thanks for the plan and for being proactive. I reviewed the spreadsheet. High level: I can cover Priya's 1:1s and take point on the calibration logistics; Samir at 0.4 looks reasonable operationally but I'll need his manager to sign off on the time shift.

Action items from my side:
- I'll ping Samir's manager (Jorge) for availability and confirm the 0.4 allocation today.
- I'll confirm the sprint delay for metrics-export with the release manager (CC'd) and update the plan if we need to expand scope.
- If legal/HR want a short justification note, I'll draft a one-paragraph exception rationale.

For the DocuSign: Rachel, can you add the manager signature (Vivek or Laura) to the approval PDF before I reach out to Jorge?

Monica
Monica Patel
Manager, ML Platforms

On a related note: please copy me on the HR thread so I can track the exception timeline.

Thanks — I reviewed. I'm comfortable approving the temporary reallocation provided two things happen:
1) We get signoff from Samir's manager (no surprises to his roadmap).
2) We capture the duration window explicitly in DocuSign (start 2027-01-04, end 2027-01-29).

Vivek, can you confirm if we should also include a short note about performance calibration contacts (so reviewers know who covered which signals)? I want the calibration committee to have a clear audit trail.

Laura
VP, Product Operations

P.S. Rachel — once Monica confirms Jorge's availability, forward me the final DocuSign link and I'll sign this week.
